timeline.event: Early humans make the oldest known stone tools at Lomekwi
timeline.label: c. 3.3 million years ago

timeline.event: Turkana Boy, an early human, lives near Lake Turkana
timeline.label: c. 1.5 million years ago

timeline.event: The Swahili trading town of Gedi is founded on the coast
timeline.label: c. 1100

timeline.event: Vasco da Gama reaches Malindi on his way to India
The Portuguese begin building Fort Jesus in Mombasa
Omani forces capture Fort Jesus after a long siege
The Imperial British East Africa Company receives its royal charter
Britain declares the East Africa Protectorate
Nairobi is founded as a depot on the Uganda Railway
The protectorate becomes the Colony of Kenya
Eliud Mathu becomes the first African on the Legislative Council
Britain declares a state of emergency as the Mau Mau uprising grows
Kenya gains independence from Britain
Kenya becomes a republic with Jomo Kenyatta as president
Kip Keino wins Olympic gold in the metric mile in Mexico City
Daniel arap Moi becomes Kenya's second president
Kenya restores multi-party politics
Wangari Maathai wins the Nobel Peace Prize
Safaricom launches the M-Pesa mobile money service
Kenyans approve a new constitution in a referendum

places.name: Nairobi
places.clue: Kenya's capital began as a railway depot in 1899 and has a national park within its city limits.

places.name: Fort Jesus, Mombasa
places.clue: A Portuguese fort of the 1590s guarding the harbour of Kenya's great port city.

places.name: Maasai Mara National Reserve
places.clue: Stage for the Great Migration, when wildebeest herds cross the Mara River.

places.name: Mount Kenya
places.clue: Africa's second-highest mountain, which gave the country its name.

places.name: Amboseli National Park
places.clue: Famous for elephant herds with Tanzania's Kilimanjaro rising just across the border.

places.name: Lamu Old Town
places.clue: A car-free Swahili island town of carved wooden doors, travelled by donkey and dhow.

places.name: Lake Nakuru
places.clue: Rift Valley soda lake famed for flamingos and a rhino sanctuary.

places.name: Kisumu
places.clue: Kenya's main port on Lake Victoria, once the end of the Uganda Railway.

places.name: Tsavo East National Park
places.clue: One of Kenya's largest parks, known for elephants dusted red by its soil.

places.name: Lake Turkana
places.clue: The world's largest permanent desert lake, nicknamed the Jade Sea.

places.name: Gedi Ruins
places.clue: Coral-stone ruins of a Swahili town abandoned in the 1600s, hidden in coastal forest.

places.name: Thimlich Ohinga
places.clue: UNESCO-listed dry-stone enclosures built without mortar near Lake Victoria.
